title: Skin Care for a Goa Beach Trip: What to Pack and Do
ex: A simple plan for a Goa beach holiday: water-resistant sunscreen, a small kit, a daily routine for sun, salt and sand, and gentle night care.
rt: Skin Care for a Goa Beach Trip: Kit & Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for a Goa beach trip: what to pack, how often to reapply sunscreen, rinsing off salt and sand, and a gentle night routine for sun-exposed skin.
keyword: skin care for goa beach trip
quick: On a Goa beach trip, wear water-resistant SPF 30+ sunscreen and reapply it every 2 hours and after every swim or towel-dry. Use a hat, sunglasses and midday shade. At night, rinse off salt and sand and use a light, soothing moisturiser instead of strong actives.
